senses.gloss:
अबुद्ध a. Foolish, unwise;
अपवादमात्रमबुद्धानां Sāṅ. S.

अबुद्धिः f.
1 Want of
understanding.
--2 Ignorance, stupidity; ˚मत्
foolish, ignorant. --a. Ignorant,
dull-witted, stupid.
--Comp.
--पूर्व,
--पूर्वक a. {1} not preceded by
knowledge or consciousness; not wanton or
intentional. {2} beginning with
non-intelligence.
--(र्वं, --र्वकं) adv.
unconsciously, ignorantly.

अबुध् --बुध a. Foolish, stupid. --m.
A fool. --f. (अभुत्) Ignorance, want
of intellect.

आबुध् {c1c} P. To perceive, notice,
understand (Ved.).

अबुध् --बुध a. Foolish, stupid. --m.
A fool. --f. (अभुत्) Ignorance, want
of intellect.

अबुध्य a. Ved. Not to be
perceived or awakened.

अबुध्न a. Having no bottom or
root, bottomless.
--ध्नं Ved. The air
or intermediate region.
